requirement: Bash script run every five minutes from cron (set -euo pipefail): queries Prometheus 3 over its HTTP API for several conditions and sends push alerts.

expected.what: `grep -m1` in the HUNG_AGE pipeline under set -e + pipefail aborts the whole script (no match → exit 1; or SIGPIPE on printf when there is a match with long output). Checks after it (certificates, backups) silently never run.

prom_instances encodes only spaces and double quotes. Queries with { } = ! + are sent unencoded; Prometheus answers with a parse error, which the parser swallows as 'no results' — host-down and website-down checks never fire.
